scoringRule: score may only be set once evidenceLevel is RUNTIME_VERIFIED and missingEvidence is empty; a score of 9.80 or higher additionally requires decision GO. Enforced by npm run guard:release-scorecard.

evidenceCodes.E1: Clean immutable candidate plus final check/lint/format/tests/coverage/SAST/secret-scan/SBOM outputs
evidenceCodes.E2: Signed Android and iOS artifacts, checksums, signing continuity, symbols, published-binary OTA inspection
evidenceCodes.E3: Real Android+iOS device matrix: P0 E2E, accessibility, startup/FPS/memory, offline/process death, push/deep links, battery
evidenceCodes.E4: Isolated staging migration replay, DB lint, RLS/IDOR personas, concurrency/query plans, k6/pool/lock, backup/PITR and Storage restore
evidenceCodes.E5: Cloudflare/Supabase provider state: zone/DNS/WAF/secrets, preview traffic, origin observe/enforce, leakage tests and rollback run
evidenceCodes.E6: Sentry/Cloudflare/Supabase dashboards: release health, symbolication, PII sample, SLO baseline, alerts and incident drill
evidenceCodes.E7: GitHub environment protection, least-privilege credential review, TestFlight/Internal Track, privacy/UGC/store forms
evidenceCodes.E8: Observed Worker and OTA staged rollout, component-independent rollback, previous/embedded update, signed GO/NO-GO record
